title: MultiCard: Multiple Attribute Cardinality Estimation via Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cardinality estimation is essential for query optimization, but most existing learned estimators focus on a single predicate type, such as string LIKE clauses or numerical range filters. In practice, analytical workloads often combine both types, while the accuracy of string estimators tends to decrease with longer patterns. We introduce MultiCard, a comprehensive learned cardinality estimator that unifies LIKE predicates and numerical filters within a single end-to-end architecture. By combining a Transformer for long-range sparse patterns with an LSTM for short, frequent patterns, MultiCard achieves robust pattern modeling. In parallel, a numerical encoder integrates catalog histograms and structural predicate features, enabling the model to dynamically assess histogram estimation accuracy across different operators and data skew conditions. translated_title: MultiCard：基于深度学习的多属性基数估计
translated_abstract: 基数估计对查询优化至关重要，但现有的学习型估计器大多只关注单一类型的谓词，例如字符串 LIKE 子句或数值范围过滤条件。在实际应用中，分析型工作负载往往同时包含这两类谓词，而且字符串估计器的准确率通常会随着模式变长而下降。我们提出了 MultiCard，一个全面的学习型基数估计器，它在单一的端到端架构中统一处理 LIKE 谓词和数值过滤条件。通过将用于处理长而稀疏模式的 Transformer 与用于处理短而高频模式的 LSTM 相结合，MultiCard 实现了鲁棒的模式建模。与此同时，一个数值编码器整合了数据目录中的直方图和结构化谓词特征，使模型能够在不同算子和数据倾斜条件下动态评估直方图估计的准确性。最后一个 Transformer 层捕捉异构谓词之间的交互，然后经过多……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MultiCard 提出了一个统一的端到端深度学习基数估计器，通过 Transformer 与 LSTM 相结合来同时处理 LIKE 字符串谓词和数值过滤谓词，并能动态评估直方图估计在不同算子和数据倾斜条件下的准确性。
en_tdlr: MultiCard introduces a unified end-to-end deep learning cardinality estimator that handles both string LIKE predicates and numerical range filters by combining Transformer and LSTM for robust pattern modeling, while dynamically assessing histogram estimation accuracy across different operators and data skew conditions.
